source: Aligned with the curated egg guide. Star Rewards and anniversary pools checked against official September notes on November 8, 2026. Unknown individual odds remain unpublished.

eggs.name: Starter Egg
eggs.notes: Starter Egg rewards use two hatch pools: Cat or Dog, then Ant or Mouse from later Guide eggs.

eggs.name: Wrapped Doll

eggs.name: Gemstone Egg
eggs.notes: Current Star Rewards egg released September 11, 2026. Adopt Me published the 0.05% Amethyst Penguin chance, but did not publish individual rates for the other ten pets.

eggs.notes: Roblox 20th anniversary egg sold by Eggburt. Adopt Me confirmed Blue Cat and Pink Dog as the two outcomes but did not publish their rarities or individual odds.
